_comment: Print specs for Face Tracking. MediaPipe FaceLandmarker 468 landmarks · 11 live signals @10 Hz · 10 pre-built detections · TTS 12 locales · optional micro:bit V2 BLE.

en.posterSubtitle: Google MediaPipe in a browser tab. The webcam stream stays on the device.

features.p: Google's MediaPipe FaceLandmarker runs locally — no upload. 11 signals stream at 10 Hz.
Smile, wink, blink, mouth open, eyebrow raise, head-yaw, head-pitch, head-roll, tongue out and more.
Narrate signals in 12 languages. Optional micro:bit V2: 19-digit packet → LED arrows.

steps: Open Chrome or Edge on any laptop.
(Optional) pair a micro:bit for LED output.
en.qrCaption: Scan to try the live demo
en.footerLeft: Chrome / Edge · No account · Webcam stays local
en.footerRight: MediaPipe · MakeCode firmware · Open source friendly
en.flyerTagline: The browser IS the face-tracking lab.
en.motto: A thousand students, zero pixels uploaded.

fr.posterSubtitle: Google MediaPipe dans un onglet. La webcam ne quitte jamais l'appareil.

features.p: MediaPipe FaceLandmarker de Google, en local — aucun upload. 11 signaux à 10 Hz.
Sourire, clin d'œil, clignement, bouche ouverte, sourcil levé, tête (yaw/pitch/roll), langue sortie…
Narration des signaux en 12 locales. Option micro:bit V2 : paquet 19 chiffres → flèches LED.

steps: Vois les 468 points + signaux en direct.
Active/désactive des détections, règle les seuils.
(Optionnel) connecte un micro:bit pour la sortie LED.

features.p: MediaPipe FaceLandmarker من Google محلياً — بدون رفع. 11 إشارة عند 10 هرتز.
ابتسامة، غمزة، رمش، فتح الفم، رفع الحاجب، دوران/ميلان الرأس، إخراج اللسان…
نطق الإشارات بـ 12 لغة. اختيارياً micro:bit V2: حزمة 19 رقماً → أسهم LED.
